char-transformer.safetensors.label: Character transformer, TinyShakespeare
char-transformer.safetensors.description: The Character transformer (GPT) template trained for 2000 steps on TinyShakespeare (about 1 minute on a laptop CPU): 3 blocks, d_model 128, 4 heads.

llama.safetensors.label: Llama character model, TinyShakespeare
llama.safetensors.description: The Llama paper's character model trained for 3000 steps on TinyShakespeare (about 2 minutes on a laptop CPU): 4 layers of RMSNorm, rotary attention and SwiGLU, d_model 128, 4 heads.
